params.message:
Home hero: compact on desktop so it fits a 1440x900 screen

With the intro as paragraphs and a list the hero grew to 798px: on 1440x900 the category
bar fell below the fold and on 1366x768 the buttons did. From lg on the padding is 48px
instead of 112px and the service list runs on in a row (two lines instead of four). The
hero is now 610px; phones keep the stacked list.
